# Application API, Extension SPI и типизированные ошибки

Source: [JSON](../../../phases/P04/phase.json). This view is for people; agents use JSON through the Task API.

## Design

detailed

## Goal

Символьная публичная поверхность вместо namespace lists: явные Api/Spi, source scanner,
per-package php-api/1, typed DTO/model boundary, минимальные extension ports, compiled
package error registry и scoped error wire values. Это смысловой pre-1.0 переход D01,
не механический rename P03. Закрывает 68 public-by-usage и 91 same-package R5 шов;
новый гейт идёт report → surface/DTO → errors → strict graph/manifest/BC/docs.
Факты: 1117 package types + 56 product consumers; 171 cross symbols; 85 constructor
sites. Counts — reference for coverage, not hardcoded future acceptance.

> **Phase Assurance | v1.**
> Impact: public-contract
> Integration Seams: symbol-surface · package-graph · module-layout · model-dto · task-transaction-capture · error-registry · golden-bc · ci-docs
> Live or Irreversible: no
> Audit Intent: auto
> Rationale: меняются публичные сигнатуры и error values; нужны independent full reviews и негативные controls. Adversarial phase audit только по отдельному owner admission; final item закрывает фазу по принятому lifecycle.

> Окружение: scripts/php84; python3; isolated PostgreSQL `_test` на 127.0.0.1:5432
> по P01/P03. Test preflight до mutating тестов. Local source authority; push/hosted CI
> не входят (D47). Multi-agent orchestration/workflow asset фаза не объявляет.

## DoR

- [x] P03 terminal GREEN, previous phase code is actual design baseline.
- [x] D06/D07/D10 + 68 rows/159 residual records read and source inventory reproduced.
- [x] Source-grounded classification table and error site map captured; scanner/DTO/error boundaries settled D63/D64.
- [x] External-sensitive attributes/RFC facts retrieved, Roave filter checked in installed primary code; captures linked.
- [x] Four outcome contracts, <=8 ordered reads, supporting artifacts bound in every Inputs; future producer evidence deferred.

## Scope Included

1. P04.1: Api/Spi/SpiKind, typed source/report scanner and fixtures, snapshot schema + Attribute layout seam.
2. P04.2: all package verdicts, consumer DTO/port changes, real model extension SPI, task transaction capture, R3/R5 zero, reviewed Golden delta.
3. P04.3: ErrorCode/ProblemDefinition/compiled registry, safe coded errors/enums, literal gate + dynamic replay, scoped wire values.
4. P04.4: strict cutover, remove namespace metadata, source-fresh manifests/reference docs, BC layer policy + negative probes.

## Scope Excluded

Typed config compilation/composition redesign P05; HTTP transport policy P06; tenancy
engine/access ownership P07; migrations/data schema P08; split/publication/tags P09;
product-wide layout/public annotation mandate; new extender; aliases/deprecated bridges.

## Dependencies

P03 closed. Strictly P04.1 → P04.2 → P04.3 → P04.4. P04.4 also consumes explicit
P04.2 classification result and P04.3 registry evidence; artifacts absent until producers
finish. No speculative bundles or fabricated producer output. P05 design starts after
P04 close and reads actual result, not this phase's prediction.

## Code/Evidence Map

`@plan/knowledge/research-P04-design.json` §1 (code anchors), §2 (facts/reproduction), §3 (algorithms/runbooks),
§4 (approved Golden delta), §5 (repair playbook), §6 (self-check).
`artifacts/P04-design/classification.tsv`, `public-by-usage-verdicts.tsv`, `error-code-map.tsv`,
`facts/source-inventory.json`, `facts/summary.json`, `facts/module-layout-residual.json`.
`input-manifest.json` pins raw maps by sha256; their referenced payload is not copied into
execution bundles. Read only affected source rows; verify all bytes with input digest script.

## Pitfalls

- Spi Call annotation alone cannot exempt R3/R5 or publish all concrete helpers.
- Replacing `saving` observer by after-commit callback changes transactional receipt capture.
- Namespace public carrier retires last; report exit 0 can contain debt.
- Golden baseline changes only through D64 reviewed semantic delta; routes unchanged.
- Roave source membership must preserve removed public types from base revision.
- ErrorCode enum constructor typing + registry ownership validation are both required.

## Validation (phase-level)

Every item Validation GREEN; final `php-api --strict --check` and error registry check exit 0,
module-layout all R0–R5=0 with empty baseline, graph negatives intact, 20 manifests source-fresh,
public-api namespace metadata absent, SQLite/PG/packages/arch/Golden green, no weakened ceiling
or missing mutation control, independent full review per item. Design-only finalization runs
Task plan-lint, dry renders ready P04.1 bundle; no runtime GREEN claimed before execution.

## Deliverables

Attrs/scanner/strict gates; all-type classified surface + minimal DTO/SPI; compiled typed
error registry; 20 generated package manifests + reference/BC policy; review/delta evidence
and exact predecessor deliverables from items.
